description: This file manages Krisp SDK instances for pipecat audio, including SDK initialization, reference counting, and utility functions for sample rate and frame duration conversions.

classes.name: KrispVivaSDKManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing Krisp SDK initialization, cleanup, and reference counting with thread safety.

methods.name: int_to_krisp_sample_rate
methods.description: Converts integer sample rate to Krisp SDK enum value, raises ValueError if unsupported.

methods.name: int_to_krisp_frame_duration
methods.description: Converts integer frame duration to Krisp SDK enum value, raises ValueError if unsupported.
